summary: Modern Times Group MTG AB, through its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of game franchises in Sweden, the United Kingdom, Germany, rest of Europe, Singapore, India, the United States, and New Zealand. The company also provides in-app purchase, in-app advertising, and other digital distribution services. In addition, it develops and publishes mobile and online games under the PlaySimple, Plarium, InnoGames, Snowprint, Hutch, Futureplay, and Ninja Kiwi names. Modern Times Group MTG AB was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
